title.zh: Zcash Developer Zakura Proposes Fix to Stop Quantum Computers Linking Shielded Swaps
title.en: Zcash Developer Zakura Proposes Fix to Stop Quantum Computers Linking Shielded Swaps

current_state.zh: Zakura proposed one-time viewing keys to prevent future quantum computers from linking shielded Zcash swaps, including those routed through NEAR Intents, with wallet support expected in coming weeks.
